_note: PX2 D controlled read-only Google state: browser fetch returns connected with zero external events; personal schedule stays on the isolated local API.

steps.eval: (() => { const original = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input); if (url.includes('/api/calendar/external-events')) return Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { provider: 'google_calendar', connection: 'connected', events: [], asOf: new Date().toISOString(), skipped: 0 } }), { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } })); return original(input, init); }; })()
